rationale: The change alters the interface supplying obstacle information to the Observable Representation, specifically the source of obstacle-presence information. In the baseline, H1-ORR1 depends on assumption H1-A1 and revalidation condition H1-RC1, which is triggered when the obstacle-detection requirements, architectural responsibility for obstacle information, or the information supplied for representing obstacle presence changes. The Evaluation Target and Phenomenon of Interest remain applicable, and the object-category and distance-related bases are unchanged, so only H1-ORR1 must be revalidated.
